milestones.description: Reset deasserted, system out of reset.
A master (e.g., FC_DATA) issues a request to an address in the TCDM range (>= 0x1C000000 and > 0x1C080000). The demux routes it to the TCDM path.
The request propagates through the demux to the XBAR input. The address is placed on TCDM_data_add_DEM_TO_XBAR for the corresponding master index (e.g., index 4 for FC_DATA).
The XBAR_L2 grants the request, asserting the grant signal for that master.
The grant signal for the master is active, making the vector TCDM_data_gnt_DEM_TO_XBAR non-zero, triggering the assertion's antecedent.
Verification Target: The consequent must hold - the address on TCDM_data_add_DEM_TO_XBAR must be >= 0x1C000000 and > 0x1C080000.
